course_position.stage_name: Solid B1+ to Low B2 Development

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Use innan and medan to describe sequence and simultaneous actions in everyday logistics.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Coordinating errands before a deadline while someone else does another task at the same time.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining what must happen before something else and what can happen in parallel.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik coordinate shopping, laundry, and a phone call before an evening commitment.

main_focus.name: sequence and parallel action with innan and medan
main_focus.description: Use innan for an action before another event and medan for two actions happening at the same time.
model_examples: Jag ringer innan vi åker hem.
Du kan handla medan jag bokar tvättid.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use innan 3-4 times and medan 2-3 times to organize the shared tasks.

allowed_supporting_grammar: om and när clauses for timing
present tense and ska for planned actions
avoid_grammar: advanced temporal connectors such as såvida inte

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use everyday task vocabulary with clear sequencing and parallel-task chunks.

dialogue_shape.opening: A short list of errands and a time limit are introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They divide tasks and explain what should happen before or during another action.
dialogue_shape.ending: They settle on an efficient order for the errands.

target_complexity.repetition: Review om or när only where needed; innan and medan should carry the lesson.

focus: the tasks that need to be completed
which actions happen before other actions
how the tasks are divided to save time

sentence_focus: one sentence with innan and a deadline
one sentence with medan and parallel actions
one sentence explaining why the order is practical
